name: Time & Temperature Display
author: rwolfe0
description: Shows a large clock over a smaller outdoor temperature on an LED panel matrix (or any Pixel Overlay Model). Temperature comes from a WeatherFlow Tempest station or from Open-Meteo. Start and stop it from the FPP scheduler with the included commands; it steps aside automatically while a playlist is playing.

privacy.summary: Fetches the current temperature about once a minute while the display is on. With a Tempest station it sends your station ID and access token to WeatherFlow; otherwise it sends the latitude/longitude saved in FPP to Open-Meteo. Nothing else leaves the device.

sends.what: your Tempest station ID and personal access token
sends.why: to read the current temperature from your own weather station

sends.what: the latitude and longitude saved in FPP settings
sends.why: to read the current temperature when no Tempest station is configured
